key_claims.claim: Right-sided CDH demonstrates attenuated lung growth response to FETO compared to left-sided, and longer tracheal occlusion duration correlates with greater o/e-LHR gain
Trio-exome Mendelian inheritance error analysis detects UPD including heterodisomies missed by standard AOH methods, resolving over half of discordant NIPT cases and unexplained FGR prenatally
Real-world cfDNA PPV varies across platforms, with laboratory-developed tests outperforming commercial assays for common trisomies in Belgian multicenter data
Approximately 18 percent of postnatally diagnosed monogenic conditions could have been detected prenatally had exome sequencing been available at the time of ultrasound findings
Interhemispheric fissure distortion is a frequent ultrasound finding in open spina bifida that partially resolves after prenatal closure
